fullDesc: Nintendo released The Legend of Zelda in Japan in 1986, created by Shigeru Miyamoto and Takashi Tezuka. It let players explore a large world in any order and was one of the first console games to save progress on the cartridge.
realFacts: The NES version in 1987 used a battery to save progress
The series has produced dozens of games
Breath of the Wild in 2017 reimagined its open world
Miyamoto based it on exploring the countryside as a child
